SCOPE: the brief is about utility CSP power plants (14-370 MWe). Only rows that transfer to an industrial concentrating-solar HEAT archetype are in the main file: description and state of development (Table 1 process), delivered-heat temperature (the heat-transfer-fluid temperature, Table 1, one row per Table 1 column, case in brackets), and lifetime and construction time (Table 6, one row per column). Four technologies: parabolic trough and linear Fresnel (examples of solar-concentrator_thermal) and tower and dish (examples of solar-concentrator_high-temperature). Table 1 and Table 6 are separate processes. Every electricity cost (USD/kWe capex including the power block, LCOE, O&M per MWh, cost breakdown; Tables 3, 4, 5, 6 and text) is in the _electricity-costs sidecar; power-plant performance (electric efficiency, capacity factor, MWe size, storage hours, land and water use; Tables 1, 4 (water), 6) is in _power-plant-performance; Table 6 projections and market figures in _projections. Not extracted: Table 2 (qualitative technical advances), Figure 4 (LCOE scatter). Capacity rows are not in the main file because every size is an electric power-plant size.

(1) Two tables are numbered 'Table 4' (water use, p.11 left; LCOE assumptions, p.11 right). (2) The p.9 text refers to 'Table 6' for LCOE vs interest rate and capacity factor; that table is Table 5. (3) Page 10 is blank. (4) Table 1 (body) and Table 6 (summary) disagree: FR HTF temperature 250 vs 270 degC; SD 750 vs >800 degC; FR capacity factor 22-24 vs 25-28; ST molten-salt capacity factor 55-70 vs >70; PT efficiency 14 vs 13-15; the ST 50-370 MW column is 'comm' in Table 1 but 'under construction/planned' in Table 6. (5) Table 1 cells wrap over two lines ('29-43', '55-70', '22-24', '70-80', '60-70', '50-280', '50-370'), and the plain-text layer separates them from their row. (6) PT no-storage investment cost has four versions: 4,500-8,000 (Table 6), 4,600-7,100 (p.6), 5,500-8,000 (IRENA, p.6), 4,600 (Table 4). (7) PT no-storage LCOE 2011 is 300-350 in Table 6 but 300-370 in the p.8 text; 2015 PT no storage 260-330 vs 260-340; ST 6-9 h 2015 175-240 vs 170-240. (8) IEA investment range printed 4,200-8,500 (p.2) and 4,200-8,400 (p.6). (9) Table 6 SD capacity factor '28-30a' has a footnote marker 'a' that is never explained. (10) Typos: 'a&-h storage' (p.8), 'USd40/kWh' (p.8), '12-15h stor.ge' (Table 4), 'couldgrow' (Table 6). (11) Table 3 Hinkley rows fill only the Low columns; read as text they look like 2011 Low/High. (12) Table 1 prints SD HTF temperature 750 while its heat-transfer-fluid cell is 'na'. (13) Cooling water: 2-3 m3/MWh (p.5) vs ~0.3-3 m3/MWh (Table 6) vs 725-1,057 gal/MWh (Table 4). (14) Global capacity projections differ: 150 GW (Table 6) vs 148 and 147 GW (p.11) for 2020; 337 (Table 6) vs about 350 GW (p.2) for 2030.
